faNexus.Name: Enable FA Nexus Forge compatibility
faNexus.Hint: Uses Forge's world-owner metadata for FA Nexus asset URL detection when available, retaining Nexus's fallback otherwise. Requires FA Nexus and a reload when changed.

scenePacker.Name: Enable Scene Packer compatibility for MAD maps
scenePacker.Hint: Allows MAD map packs to initialize when their ignored prefab compendium is unavailable in this world. Existing exclusions are retained. Requires Scene Packer and a reload when changed.

argonCombatHud.Name: Enable Argon Combat HUD compatibility
argonCombatHud.Hint: Provides WFRP4e panels, actions, movement, weapon sets, and actor configuration for Argon. Requires an enabled Argon - Combat HUD module and a reload when changed.

paperDoll.Name: Enable Paper Doll compatibility
paperDoll.Hint: Synchronizes WFRP4e equipment, validates slots, and adds WFRP4e tooltips for Paper Doll. Requires an enabled Paper Doll module and a reload when changed.

paperDollArgonBridge.Name: Enable Paper Doll–Argon equipment bridge
paperDollArgonBridge.Hint: Shows Paper Doll ready and quick-use items on Argon and copies Paper Doll's physical hand slots into the active Argon weapon set. Requires both features and a reload when changed.

bossBar.Name: Enable Boss Bar compatibility
bossBar.Hint: Offers WFRP4e setup, removes the WFRP application frame from Boss Bar, and enables configurable combat selection and Up in Arms bars. Requires Boss Bar and a reload when changed.

ArgonCombatItemPatterns.Name: Argon combat item patterns
ArgonCombatItemPatterns.Hint: Comma, semicolon, or line separated item-name patterns for the HUD Items action menu. Use * as a wildcard, such as *Draught* or *Potion*.

WeaponSets.Label: Switch WFRP equipment with weapon sets
WeaponSets.Hint: When enabled, selecting an Argon weapon set equips that set's weapons and unequips weapons from the other Argon sets.

Configuration.Name: WFRP4e blood preset
Configuration.Hint: Sets the WFRP4e species path, enables automatic blood colors, and adds a flavorful species palette without removing existing Splatter colors.
Configuration.Error: Splatter could not be configured. See the console for details.

BossBar.SetupDescription: Configure Boss Bar with WFRP4e defaults?
BossBar.SetupCore: The bar will use current and maximum Wounds, decreasing as Wounds are lost.
BossBar.SetupUpInArms: Use Boss Bar’s Segmented theme by default for critical capacity, with a thin Wounds bar above it.
BossBar.SetupCustomization: Existing boss selections and themes stay editable. Keep My Settings dismisses this suggestion for the current injury rules.
BossBar.Configured: Boss Bar is configured for WFRP4e.
BossBar.Error: Boss Bar compatibility encountered a problem. See the console for details.

automatic.Name: Automatically show combat bosses
automatic.Hint: At combat start, adds hostile non-player-owned enemies with a Boss trait, or selects enemies with 30+ maximum Wounds, Grim, and Leader or Champion. Existing manual selections are preserved.

stacked.Name: Stack critical capacity and Wounds bars
stacked.Hint: When WFRP’s Up in Arms critical injury option is enabled and Boss Bar uses WFRP Wounds paths, show a large primary critical capacity bar with a smaller, thinner Wounds bar directly above it. Disable to use Boss Bar’s normal health display.

woundsStyle.Name: Stacked Wounds bar theme
woundsStyle.Hint: Theme for the thin Wounds bar above the primary critical capacity bar. Edit these themes in Boss Bar’s theme configuration. The primary critical capacity bar uses the boss’s selected Boss Bar theme.
